items.title: Q-081 z_goal/z_harm_a reach pre-flight SCAN: does the landmark-manipulation lever reach the REFRAMED (z_world, z_goal) pair, falling back to (z_world, z_harm_a)?
items.note:
Follow-on of the 2026-08-01 /claim-synthesis Q-081 measured-pair reframe (REE_assembly/evidence/planning/claim_synthesis_Q-081_2026-08-01.md, session elastic-merkle-e0cca8, chip chip-20260801-q081-zgoal-probe), itself the direct successor of V3-EXQ-849 (same discipline: 824/824a/838/849 confirmed ZERO reach from four manipulation families to the now-RETIRED (z_world, operating_mode) pair; the claim-synthesis traced why -- operating_mode's precursor set has no wired edge from z_world/landmark structure at all -- and found two genuinely different, already-coded, single-hop paths from the SAME landmark-manipulation lever into cross-stream targets: z_goal (E1 gate_stream, agent.py ~4895, gated on goal.e1_goal_conditioned + goal_state.is_active()) and z_harm_a (E2_harm_a gate_stream, agent.py ~8332, gated on agent.e2_harm_a configured). Per the same discipline, this is a cheap pre-flight reach probe for the new pair(s) BEFORE any full multi-seed recording run.

SUBSTRATE (built this session): experiments/_lib/q081_pair_reach_check_stream.py -- a generalisation of q081_pair_reach_check.py (Q081-REACH-CHECK-PAIR-SPECIFIC) parametrised by target stream ('z_goal' or 'z_harm_a'), reusing that module's pure comparator (pair_specific_reach_report) and matched-arm/RNG-reset discipline verbatim, but reading the raw+gated per-dimension tensor value of the target stream (via VsRolloutGate._gate_value, its pure non-mutating comparison, rather than the mutating public gate_stream()/gate() wrappers) instead of the salience precursor dict. Adds a SECOND non-degeneracy guard beyond the inherited boundary-event one: the target stream's own activation precondition must clear on at least one tick, or a 'no reach' verdict from an all-None trace would be vacuous.

MANUAL VALIDATION AT AUTHORING TIME (2026-08-01, this session -- see the driver script's own module docstring for full figures): z_goal's activation precondition turned out to be the HARD-to-clear one -- the OPPOSITE of the claim-synthesis doc's prediction that z_goal would have lower precondition surface than z_harm_a. A cheap single-agent scan (no scrambler/second arm) across seeds 0-4 at up to 30 episodes x 300 steps found z_goal activates within a ~600-1200 cumulative-tick budget at seeds 2/3/4, but needs MANY episode restarts (short per-episode survival under this untrained agent's own policy dominates, not a longer per-episode step cap) -- hence this script's ZGOAL_N_EPISODES=30/STEPS_PER_EPISODE=300, larger than V3-EXQ-849's 3x400 budget for the always-populated salience precursor. z_harm_a, by contrast, activates from tick 1 onward every tick once configured (use_e2_harm_a=True, set by this module for the z_harm_a target only, plus the already-profile-default use_affective_harm_stream=True) -- confirmed non-degenerate at n_episodes=1/steps=150/seed=2 (n_active_ticks=150/150). At that same cheap setting, has_pair_specific_reach was False for all three manipulation levers tried manually (iei_permute, jitter, suppress) -- carried forward as context, not assumed; this script's own multi-seed leg is what adjudicates it.

DESIGN: z_goal leg ALWAYS runs first (5 seeds x 2 levers [iei_permute known, jitter untried, matching V3-EXQ-849's own lever choice] x N_EPISODES=30/steps=300 = 10 cells). If it finds >=1 non-degenerate cell with reach: PASS, H1 for z_goal live, z_harm_a leg SKIPPED (not needed). If z_goal finds zero reach (whether genuinely tested-and-null, or fully degenerate/inactive): falls back to the z_harm_a leg (5 seeds x 2 levers x N_EPISODES=3/steps=200 = 10 cells, cheap given immediate activation). Final verdict cascades: z_goal reach found > z_harm_a fallback reach found > both genuinely null (informative, PASS, recommend escalating past a config-lever probe per the claim-synthesis doc's own note) > both fully degenerate (FAIL, substrate_not_ready_requeue, re-queue with a larger budget). This probe does NOT adjudicate Q-081 Outcome A vs B and does NOT itself queue any substrate change -- per the claim-synthesis doc, a direct write-path substrate build (if both targets come back genuinely zero-reach) is a governance decision, out of scope for /queue-experiment.

GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout (precursor-level has_pair_specific_reach for z_goal and, conditionally, z_harm_a) has never been computed by any prior run -- 824/824a/838/849 all tested the now-retired (z_world, operating_mode) pair exclusively; q081_pair_reach_check_stream.py did not exist before this session. Not recoverable by reanalysis -> proceed to author.

Substrate readiness (Step 2.5): both gate_stream call sites, VsRolloutGate._gate_value, GoalState.is_active()/update()/StepHarness's canonical update_z_goal wiring, and E2HarmAForward's use_e2_harm_a construction path all re-read directly from current ree_core source this session (agent.py, vs_rollout_gate.py, goal.py, _harness.py, config.py). No new build needed -- this is a diagnostic reach-scan over already-coded, already-config-reachable paths.

Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): does not fire -- Q-081's chain (824/824a/838, autopsy-confirmed measurement_test_design_defect) plus 849 (diagnostic PASS, non_contributory) is entirely the measurement_test_design_defect / diagnostic-reach-scan category, not substrate_ceiling; this run also targets a DIFFERENT measured pair (z_goal/z_harm_a, not operating_mode), so even a same-category count would not be a same-mechanism re-test.

DV-symmetry (604c): not applicable -- this is a diagnostic reach probe over a boolean precursor-divergence detector (per-dimension float diff, tol=0.0), not an arm scored against a DV symmetry class.

Code review (Step 3.5): claim_ids=['Q-081'] (only claim this run's implementation tests); EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE='diagnostic' correct (reach-scan, not a claim-hypothesis test); ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT declared and justified by this session's own manual single-agent + full-probe validation (see script docstring); preconditions[]/criteria_non_degenerate/load_bearing criterion all present per the diagnostic adjudication gate (combined 'at_least_one_target_has_a_non_degenerate_cell' is the load-bearing precondition; per-target non-degeneracy is informational, correctly not gating alone since the fallback cascade means one target's degeneracy does not invalidate the other's reading); substrate API re-verified live (not copied from 849 unchecked -- new call sites: GoalState, E2HarmAForward, VsRolloutGate._gate_value); output contract (run_id _v3, architecture_epoch, outcome exact field, write_flat_manifest stamps recording core via config/seeds/script_path/started_at, matching 849's own pattern) verified; not multi-arm in the arm_fingerprint sense (results recorded under zgoal_leg/zharm_a_leg, not arm_results -- no training, no reuse-eligible baseline arm to mint), confirmed by validate_experiments.py's own 0 arm-fingerprint-backlog finding.

validate_experiments.py --strict --paths experiments/v3_exq_865_q081_zgoal_reach_preflight_scan.py: OK, 0 non-conforming, 0 warnings of any kind. Smoke (--dry-run, 1 seed x 2 levers x both legs at n_episodes=1/steps=20 toy scale): pipeline runs end to end, z_goal leg correctly falls back to z_harm_a leg (z_goal degenerate at toy scale as expected), self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue at this toy scale (informative, not a crash -- matches 849's own toy-scale dry-run self-route). tests/contracts/test_q081_pair_reach_check_stream.py (21, new this session, incl. 2 live-substrate smoke tests pinning the real measured boundary-event/activation figures cited above) + tests/contracts/test_q081_pair_reach_check.py (15, pre-existing, unmodified) all pass locally.

items.title: Q-040c dACC PE-weight delta correlation, config fix + pre-flight smoke gate (supersedes V3-EXQ-475b)
items.note: Successor to V3-EXQ-475b in the goal_pipeline:GAP-4 Tier-1 cohort. 475b FAILed at precondition P2 (dACC engagement): 0/6 seed-x-arm cells showed any dACC firing (n_dacc_fires=0 throughout, confirmed via REE_assembly/evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-475b_2026-08-01.md). Root cause code-traced: ree_core/agent.py gates dACC's forward pass on `self.dacc is not None and z_harm_a is not None`; z_harm_a stayed structurally None because 475b's _build_arm_config called _lib.goal_pipeline_tier1.build_config(env, gap4_arm) WITHOUT enable_affective_harm_stream=True (default False; that flag is what wires use_harm_stream/use_affective_harm_stream/z_harm_a_dim into the config on the gap4_operating branch) -- the exact V3-EXQ-620/625 measurement-artifact footgun build_config's own docstring names by precedent. FIX (only substantive change from 475b): _build_arm_config now passes enable_affective_harm_stream=True; run_seed_arm also now stamps env._exq_env_kwargs explicitly (was previously coincidental via the module default) since that flag's branch reads limb_damage_enabled off it. Everything else -- P1 MECH-269b V_s-gating precondition, the Spearman-rho(|PE|, dACC bias-magnitude) correlation statistic, seeds 42/7/19, the 2-arm ARM_vs_off/ARM_vs_on structure, acceptance thresholds -- is unchanged. NEW: pre-flight smoke gate (autopsy learning #3) -- _preflight_dacc_engagement_check() runs a cheap pilot rollout (ARM_vs_on, seed 42, 3 warmup + 1 eval episode x 20 steps) BEFORE the full 3-seed x 2-arm design and raises PreflightDaccNotFiring (uncaught, fail-fast ERROR) if n_dacc_fires==0, so a structurally-dead dACC is caught in seconds rather than after the full ~90min budget. Verified both directions this session: with the fix, preflight measured n_dacc_fires=20/20 pilot steps and the full --dry-run's two cells measured n_dacc_fires=[48,48] (nonzero, confirms engagement); a monkeypatched negative control (forcing enable_affective_harm_stream=False, i.e. reproducing 475b's exact bug) correctly raised PreflightDaccNotFiring with n_dacc_fires=0. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout is the dACC bias-magnitude vs precision-weighted-PE correlation WITH dACC actually engaging. `reanalysis_query.py query --readout rho_pe_vs_bias_magnitude --claim Q-040` returns exactly one manifest (475b's own), whose n_dacc_fires=0 in every cell -- nothing to reanalyze. Not recoverable -> proceed to author. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): 0 prior substrate_ceiling autopsies tag claim_ids=["Q-040"] (checked via the skill's standard grep-count method over REE_assembly/evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_*.json) -- does not fire. 475b's own autopsy is a non_contributory driver-bug category (measurement/instrumentation), not substrate_ceiling, and is correctly excluded by that method. conditions=2 here (not 475b's original queue entry's conditions=6, which did not match its own seeds=3 x verdict-line count -- 475b's script never actually printed a verdict line at all, a latent progress-instrumentation gap; this version adds one verdict: PASS/FAIL print per seed-x-arm cell, so seeds(3) x conditions(2) = 6 total cells = 6 verdict lines, consistent). validate_experiments.py --strict --paths experiments/v3_exq_862_q040c_dacc_pe_weight_delta_correlation.py: OK, 0 findings across all 19 checks. --dry-run: both cells complete, verdict PASS x2, correctly self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue at the 1-seed smoke scale (P1/P2 both require >=2/3 seeds, matching 475b's own smoke-scale behaviour) -- expected, not a defect.

items.title: Q-086 gentler-env confound control REDESIGN (3 arms incl. new num_hazards=0 floor, 6 seeds, survival-time DV; successor to V3-EXQ-857)
items.note:
REDESIGN of V3-EXQ-857 (Q-086 gentler-env confound control), per its confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-857_2026-08-01.md (status: confirmed) routing: "/queue-experiment a redesign with more seeds (5-10), a starker environmental gradient (e.g. num_hazards 4 vs 0), and episode-survival-time as an explicit secondary DV." 857's own readiness precondition (gentle_env_manipulation_took_z_harm_s_differs, num_hazards 4 vs 1, n=3 seeds) FAILED: cross-arm z_harm_s SNR 0.42 vs required >=2.0 -- diagnosed as a POWER problem, not a wrong hypothesis. This entry implements all three routed fixes together: (a) doubles seeds to 6, (b) adds a starker num_hazards=0/hazard_food_attraction=0.0 ARM_BENIGN floor (reported alongside 857's original ARM_GENTLE=1/0.2 for cross-attempt comparability), (c) instruments mean/min episode_survival_steps per arm as a NEW non-gating secondary precondition, directly measuring the uncounted signal 857's autopsy flagged (min_eval_steps 58 harsh vs 125 gentle). The self-route keys off the STARKEST pair (harsh vs benign), not 857's original pair. claims.yaml Q-086 already cites this routing (2026-08-01T17:22Z governance cycle, REE_assembly 5c7e5e1134) and stays candidate pending this run. Not a literal 'supersedes' of V3-EXQ-857 per the EXQ versioning policy -- 857's own non_contributory verdict already excludes it from scoring, so there is nothing for this entry to invalidate; this extends the diagnostic chain rather than correcting a bug in 857.

GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4, re-verified 2026-08-01): decisive readout = cross-arm z_harm_s SNR at num_hazards 4-vs-0. `reanalysis_query.py query --readout z_harm_s --claim Q-086` returns exactly 1 manifest (V3-EXQ-857 itself, substrate_hash 690c1ccd29756988..., ARM_HARSH num_hazards=4 + ARM_GENTLE num_hazards=1 only) -- no num_hazards=0 arm exists in the corpus. Not recoverable -> a new ARM_BENIGN cell is required, proceeded to author.

Substrate readiness (Step 2.5, re-verified 2026-08-01): claims.yaml Q-086 is status=candidate, no v3_pending / implementation_phase:v3 gate. Reuses the affective_fishtank baseline lib verbatim (same SD-011/SD-019/MECH-219 harm-stream substrate as V3-EXQ-664/856/857, already IMPLEMENTED). num_hazards=0 verified against current ree_core/environment/causal_grid_world.py source: hazard placement is `for _ in range(min(self.num_hazards, len(forage_pool)))`, every subsequent hazard drift/move/food-attraction branch is gated on `if self.hazards:`, and background_drift_enabled defaults False and is not set by this baseline -- so num_hazards=0 gives a genuine hazard-free floor with no division-by-hazard-count or other edge case, not an untested config.

Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b, re-verified 2026-08-01): 1 counted substrate_ceiling-family autopsy on Q-086 (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-857_2026-08-01, category measurement_test_design_defect / non_contributory -- an INSTRUMENT/readiness defect owing no substrate build, not a substrate_ceiling verdict), well under threshold=2. items.title: ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-B (H2: F-dominance) -- f_weight attenuation ladder, committed-class entropy
items.note: ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-B (H2: F-dominance, downstream of selection). Design of record: REE_assembly/evidence/planning/arc_062_conversion_fanout_2026-07-29.md Section 2 Leg P-B + "P-B buildability resolution (2026-07-31)". claim_ids=[] (diagnostic; brake-exempt per fanout doc Section 4 -- P-B tests a different mechanism from Leg P-A, claim-neutral by design; not a re-derive-brake case).  (a) GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = paired-by-seed committed-class entropy across an f_weight attenuation ladder, under the lateral_pfc-routed + CRF-ON + MECH-448/449-active matched-stack config. f_weight did not exist before V3-EXQ-852 (SD-085 landed ree-v3 main 12374fb, 2026-07-31). V3-EXQ-852 itself (ree-v3 995c7db) tested f_weight only under substrate DEFAULTS, not this leg's CRF-ON matched stack; no other manifest sweeps f_weight at all. Not recoverable by reanalysis -> proceed to author.  (b) Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): claim_ids=[], brake-EXEMPT per fanout doc Section 4 ("P-B/P-C/P-D are brake-exempt... P-B tests a different mechanism").  (c) SD-085 landing: ree-v3 main 12374fb ("SD-085: E3Config.f_weight -- weight on F (reality cost) in score_trajectory"). REE_assembly/docs/architecture/ sd_085_e3_reality_cost_weight.md. E3Config.f_weight: float = 1.0 (no-op default), multiplicative coefficient on F in E3TrajectorySelector.score_trajectory (ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py:1190). Set directly post-construction (agent.e3.config.f_weight = X), matching the lambda_ethical/rho_residue sweep idiom -- not wired through REEConfig.from_dims().  (d) CORRECTED route source: this leg's matched stack uses modulatory_channel_route_source="lateral_pfc" (V3-EXQ-851's corrected value, ree-v3 3c5d45a9dd + substrate branch in ree_core/agent.py), NOT the design doc's original literal "gated_policy" text, which V3-EXQ-851's own erratum (design doc, "Erratum (2026-07-31)" section) proved does not route the rule-apprehension/CRF channel at all.  (e) NEW C1(h) F_WEIGHT_KNOB_LIVE gate: on genuine fresh-select P2 ticks (same latch-clearing discipline as C1g), confirms mean_f_weighted falls within a +/-2% interval of f_weight * mean_f_raw (agent.e3._last_traj_components), on a majority of seeds, on EVERY rung -- i.e. the f_weight knob genuinely rescales F through the FULL matched-stack pipeline at every attenuation level, not just at substrate defaults (V3-EXQ-852's scope). C1(a-g) reused verbatim from V3-EXQ-851 (same names/thresholds) but re-scoped from "both arms" to "all four rungs" since CRF is now a matched constant ON everywhere (no OFF arm in this design); C1(d) is necessarily re-expressed as a direct magnitude floor (mean_lateral_pfc_bias_abs > PROP_NONVAC_FLOOR) rather than a paired ON/OFF diff. C1_holds requires all eight sub-gates to hold at majority-of-seeds on EVERY rung. Any C1 fail on any rung -> substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a verdict.  (f) DV-symmetry declaration (mandatory, 604c net): committed-class entropy is a function of the argmax action-class sequence. f_weight rescales ONE per-candidate-VARYING term (F -- not a broadcast scalar) relative to M/Phi in the score sum; neither a uniform additive shift (argmax-cancelling) nor a whole-score monotone rescale -- so it is NOT invariant under the committed-class DV's argmax symmetry and legitimately CAN change the committed argmin, at every rung.  (g) Declared-null three-branch map (NO weakens, claim_ids=[]): (1) any C1(a-h) fails on any rung -> substrate_not_ready_requeue, evidence_direction=unknown. (2) C1 holds on all 4 rungs AND C2 holds (F000-vs-F100 committed-class-entropy lift >= 0.05 nats on >=2/3 seeds) -> f_dominance_confirmed_h2_operative_ceiling, evidence_direction=non_contributory but a load-bearing GOVERNANCE ROUTING signal (ARC-062's behavioural retest should be gated behind an F-rebalance substrate landing). (3) C1 holds AND C2 fails -> f_dominance_refuted_as_sole_cause, evidence_direction=non_contributory; per the fanout doc's P-C resolution, H3 (competence/action-learning) is already "eliminated" in hypothesis_space_registry.v1.json -- this branch corroborates the already-tracked H-observation-interface root rather than reopening H3.  (h) Code review (Step 3.5): full checklist walked against the script -- claim tagging (claim_ids=[] correct for a claim-neutral diagnostic; EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE ="diagnostic" correct); diagnostic adjudication (9 preconditions C1a-h all readiness-kind with measured/threshold/met, load_bearing C2 criterion, criteria_non_degenerate for all 9); substrate API correctness (f_weight, _last_traj_components["f"]/["f_weighted"], and the "lateral_pfc" route branch independently grepped live in ree_core before writing); phased training (P0/P1/ P2 unchanged from 851); sample-size integrity (same latch-clearing idiom as 851/791a -- last_score_diagnostics cleared before every select_action, C1g and the new C1h reads both gated on the SAME fresh-select check since _last_traj_components is populated in the same score_trajectory call); progress instrumentation ([train] ep N/M with M=total_train_eps loop bound, verdict PASS/FAIL per seed*rung = 12 lines, Seed/Condition boundary lines); output contract (run_id _v3, architecture_epoch, outcome exact field, stamp_recording_core via write_flat_manifest, z_goal_stream wired via ZGoalStreamAccumulator per 852's pattern -- an improvement over 851, which leaves it NOT RECORDED); runner conformance (emit_outcome at end of __main__, dry_run threaded through). One finding during review: validate_experiments.py flagged a new anchor-reachability WARN not present on 851 (851 is experiment_purpose="evidence", which the lint skips entirely; this script is correctly "diagnostic" per the locked design, so the identically-shaped C1a-g/h preconditions newly trip it). Resolved with a documented ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT (the preconditions are live-measurement COUNT aggregates, not known-degenerate-reference anchors -- there is no predicate-vs-frozen-reference mismatch to guard against, matching the precedent set by V3-EXQ-852's own exemption reasoning for its one by-construction precondition).  (i) Smoke test (--dry-run): all 4 rungs x 1 seed complete cleanly, verdict PASS x4, manifest written+cleaned. C1/C1h correctly read False on the tiny dry-run dose (2 P2 episodes x 30 steps cannot clear the readiness floors -- expected, matches 851's own dry-run behaviour). Independently verified the C1(h) F_WEIGHT_KNOB_LIVE logic via a direct run_experiment() call: at every rung mean_f_weighted matched f_weight*mean_f_raw within the 2% interval exactly as designed (e.g. ARM_F000 f_weight=0.0 -> mean_f_weighted=0.0 bit-exact; ARM_F100 f_weight=1.0 -> mean_f_weighted==mean_f_raw exactly), confirming the knob-live check computation is correct before the real run. [smoke] z_goal_stream: active_frac=0.000 ticks=0/455 writer_calls=455 goal_state_present=True n_agents=4 -- no writer defect (correctly wired, zero active_frac expected on the tiny dry-run dose).  (j) validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 findings across all 19 checks (0 anchor-reachability-warnings after the ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT addition; 0 arm-fingerprint-backlog; 0 stale-e3-diagnostics; 0 precondition-recomputability; 0 dead-z_goal-stream; matches V3-EXQ-851's own fully-clean state).  Reuses V3-EXQ-851's matched-stack + C1(a-g) + latch-clearing machinery verbatim per the fanout doc's own instruction ("Leg P-B... hold the rule-apprehension channel ON and lateral_pfc-routed... as a matched constant"). One deliberate deviation from 851: the within-class-representative-entropy SECONDARY negative control is dropped -- its framing ("rule bias is class-keyed, cannot move within-class selection") is specific to sweeping use_candidate_rule_field, which is now a matched constant here, not the swept variable; nothing in this leg's design spec depends on it.

items.title: ARC-062/MECH-309 full-budget replication of V3-EXQ-859: lateral_pfc route_source vs none ablation, MECH-448/449 engagement (~7.7h)
items.note: ARC-062/MECH-309 FULL-TRAINING-BUDGET replication of V3-EXQ-859's lateral_pfc-vs-none route_source ablation (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-859_2026-08-01.md, user-confirmed routing: "chip the full-training-budget (~7.7h) replication now ... rather than deferring the compute-cost judgment call to /governance"). BACKGROUND: V3-EXQ-851 (full ~7.7h, P0=200/P1=90/P2=60, seeds 42/43/44) found MECH-448 (F-eligibility demotion) completely dead (0.0) under modulatory_channel_route_source='lateral_pfc', vs robustly live (17.76) under 'cand_world_summary' in matched-stack template V3-EXQ-654j (same seeds). V3-EXQ-859 (cheap ~45min diagnostic, P0=10/P2=10, no P1) compared 'lateral_pfc' vs 'none' at the same seeds to isolate whether route_source itself is causal: MECH-448 was ALIVE in BOTH arms (3/3 seeds each) -- did NOT reproduce 851's collapse under either value. MECH-449 was dead in BOTH arms, matching its deadness in 851. Two readings remained undistinguished: (a) route_source has no causal effect on MECH-448 at all -- 851's diagnosis needs a different explanation; or (b) route_source's effect is training-duration-dependent and only emerges over a longer run, which 859's 45-minute probe cannot detect by construction. THIS RUN: same 2-arm ablation (modulatory_channel_route_source='lateral_pfc' vs 'none'), same seeds (42/43/44), same matched-stack config as V3-EXQ-859 (use_candidate_rule_field=True fixed on both arms, USE_F_ELIGIBILITY_DEMOTION/USE_GO_NOGO_CONSTITUTION/USE_DACC/USE_MODULATORY_SELECTION_AUTHORITY/USE_MODULATORY_CHANNEL_ROUTING all matched, identical ENV_KWARGS, identical CRF maturity levers, identical SD-056 online e2 training) but extended to FULL budget matching V3-EXQ-851's own schedule exactly: P0=200/P1=90/P2=60 (350 episodes/cell x 200 steps x 3 seeds x 2 arms = 420000 ticks, ~7.67h on the cloud fleet per 851's own measured elapsed_seconds=27623). P1 (bias-head REINFORCE training) is reused verbatim from V3-EXQ-851's own machinery -- 859 skipped P1 as out-of-scope for its structural-engagement question, but running it here reproduces 851's training schedule structurally, not just numerically, and does not privilege either arm since agent.lateral_pfc exists and trains on BOTH arms regardless of route_source. Primary readout is UNCHANGED from V3-EXQ-859 (NOT a rebuild of V3-EXQ-851's full C1(a-g) readiness gate + C2 committed-class-entropy falsifier apparatus): MECH-448 (f_eligibility_demotion_active_frac + mean f_eligibility_excluded_count) and MECH-449 (go_nogo_active_frac + mean safety+soft suppressions) engagement, latch-cleared on every P2 tick. claim_ids=[] (matches V3-EXQ-859's own convention -- routing diagnostic, not new MECH-309/ARC-062 evidence); experiment_purpose='diagnostic'; supersedes=null (does NOT supersede V3-EXQ-859 -- 859's short-budget result stands on its own terms as a correctly-self-routed 'needs_full_replication' finding, this is a duration-extended follow-up, not a bug-fix correction). COMPUTE COST -- FLAGGED EXPLICITLY, deliberate user judgment call (2026-08-01, chip-20260801-859-full-replication): this is a real ~7.7-HOUR compute commitment. Accepted because V3-EXQ-858 (ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-B, a 1200-minute/20-hour 4-rung f_weight attenuation ladder run) is ALREADY sitting suspended pending exactly this question -- the cost of running this once is smaller than leaving that allocation suspended indefinitely on an ambiguous short-probe result. THIS RESULT DETERMINES WHETHER V3-EXQ-858 CAN BE UNBLOCKED: V3-EXQ-858's own matched-stack config presupposes MECH-448/449 are active under lateral_pfc routing, which is exactly what is in question here. NOTE (observed at queue time, 2026-08-01): the current experiment_queue.json snapshot shows V3-EXQ-858 status='claimed' on ree-cloud-4 since 2026-08-01T12:44:33Z, not 'suspended' -- a coordinator-side hold/suspend action may not be reflected in this git-derived queue view (holds are coordinator-side per CLAUDE.md 'Phase-3 queue lever depends on op'); flagged for the user/governance to reconcile, not resolved by this queue entry. Code review (Step 3.5): script is a near-verbatim merge of V3-EXQ-859's agent config + MECH-448/449 latch-cleared readout (copied unchanged) with V3-EXQ-851's P0/P1/P2 phase structure + REINFORCE bias-head training machinery (copied unchanged, constants LR_LPFC_BIAS/ REINFORCE_BATCH_SIZE/OUTCOME_BUF_MAX/POLICY_TEMPERATURE/ADV_MIN_THRESHOLD/EMA_DECAY reused verbatim from 851). claim tagging, diagnostic adjudication (one readiness precondition, measured/threshold/met, load_bearing sample_adequate criterion, criteria_non_degenerate for both mechanisms), substrate API correctness, latch-clearing, progress instrumentation ([train] ep N/M with M=350 the loop bound, verdict PASS/FAIL per seed*arm = 6 lines, Seed/ Condition boundary lines), output contract (run_id _v3, architecture_epoch, outcome exact field, write_flat_manifest stamps recording core, z_goal_stream wired via ZGoalStreamAccumulator), runner conformance (emit_outcome at end of __main__, dry_run threaded through) all verified against current source. Checked: V3-EXQ-851 tested lateral_pfc alone (matched constant, not swept) at full budget; V3-EXQ-859 tested the lateral_pfc-vs-none sweep but only at SHORT budget (P0=10 vs this run's P0=200); no manifest anywhere sweeps route_source at matched seeds AND full training budget. Not recoverable by reanalysis -> proceed to author. items.title: MECH-166 wall-independent representation confirmer (slot_cosine_sim sole gate, ARC-065 noise-floor diversity fix)
items.note: IGW-20260801-223 (claim MECH-166, backlog EVB-0475, "Proposal for MECH-166") + IGW-20260801-225 (GOV-CONFIRM-1, "Confirm evidence: MECH-166, lit 0.88 exp ~0"). Prior draft (session 6ac06193-...-worktrees-best-practices-3e2efc, RELATIONSHIP.md + DESIGN.md) found these are the SAME evidence gap for MECH-166 (genuine_exp_count: 0 despite literature_confidence 0.876) -- one redesigned experiment discharges both, not two. Supersedes V3-EXQ-436 -> V3-EXQ-436a (both non_contributory, FAIL, conjunctive C1-AND-C2 gate). 436a's own evidence_direction_note diagnosed the root cause as a monomodal (bit-identical) waking policy starving the SWS-analog consolidation pass, and named the exact requeue condition: land ARC-065's behavioural-diversity substrate, then requeue as V3-EXQ-436b. ARC-065 is status:stable, v3_pending:False as of 2026-07-11 (claims.yaml, re-confirmed live 2026-08-01). (a) GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = slot_cosine_sim differentiation (SWS_THEN_REM vs WAKING_ONLY). reanalysis_query.py --readout slot_cosine_sim --claim MECH-166 found exactly one prior manifest (436a itself), flagged UNVERIFIABLE (no substrate_hash -- pre-recording-standard). Not recoverable by reanalysis -> proceed to author. (b) Substrate readiness (Step 2.5): ARC-065 (noise_floor.py, MECH-313) confirmed BUILT live at ree_core/policy/noise_floor.py + ree_core/utils/config.py:3238 (use_noise_floor default False, threaded via REEConfig.from_dims). MECH-313 itself is claim-status candidate/v3_pending:True but is a substrate DEPENDENCY here, not the claim under test (substrate built, evidence separate pattern) -- not a blocker. (c) Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): MECH-166 0 braking autopsies, ARC-045 0, SD-017 1 -- all below the >=2 threshold. Brake does not fire. (d) LOAD-BEARING FIX FOUND DURING RE-VERIFICATION (this is what the draft flagged as an unconfirmed open item, and it was real): noise_floor.py's own docstring states its integration site is REEAgent.select_action() -> e3.select(temperature=effective_T) (confirmed live, agent.py:7438-7444). 436a's action-selection helpers (_select_action_baseline/_select_action_context_cond) never called select_action() -- they looped over discrete actions via agent.e2.world_forward + agent.e3.harm_eval and took a deterministic argmin. Simply setting use_noise_floor=True on the config while keeping that argmin path would have had ZERO effect on trajectory diversity (noise_floor constructed but never consulted), silently reproducing 436a's exact failure. FIXED: both action-selection functions now sample via softmax(-harms/effective_T) + torch.multinomial, using agent.noise_floor.compute_effective_temperature(...) -- the same computation the substrate's own select_action() performs, applied to this driver's own harm-based candidate scores. Verified in the --dry-run smoke: per-episode action-class entropy ~1.53 nats (close to ln(5)=1.609 uniform-over-5-actions), confirming genuine stochastic diversity is now live (vs the ~0 entropy the deterministic argmin would give). A defensive `assert agent.noise_floor is not None` guards against a future wiring regression. (e) DV primacy inverted per IGW-225's explicit mandate: slot_cosine_sim is now the SOLE PASS/FAIL gate (C1: slot_cosine_sim(SWS_THEN_REM) < slot_cosine_sim(WAKING_ONLY) in >=3/5 seeds -- directional per ARC-045's own pre-registered claims.yaml experimental implication, not the 436a bidirectional-diff shape, since ARC-045/SD-017/MECH-166 predict a specific sign). Behavioural metrics (harm_rate_*) and slot_separation (C4, ARC-045 secondary) are recorded but never gate. All three claim_ids share this one wall-independent test since claims.yaml's own notes for SD-017 and ARC-045 independently specify the identical cosine_sim comparison as their experimental implication. (f) DV-symmetry declaration (604c net, mandatory): the manipulation (ran SWS+REM consolidation vs not) directly mutates agent.e1.context_memory.memory via ContextMemory.write() during sleep, and slot_cosine_sim reads that same tensor -- not a broadcast constant, monotone rescale, or permutation, so the DV is not invariant under any of the flagged symmetry classes. (g) Scope: 436a's 3rd arm (SWS_ONLY) dropped -- not required for the primary MECH-166 question; the freed budget stays on the 2-condition (WAKING_ONLY, SWS_THEN_REM) x 5-seed comparison. Non-degeneracy self-report added (check_degeneracy over slot_cosine_sim + train_action_class_entropy_mean across all 10 cells) as a guard against a silent repeat of the original bit-identical-trajectory failure. label_balance added for the harm_eval_head training signal (436a did not record this). (h) Code review (Step 3.5): full checklist walked -- claim tagging, substrate API correctness (ContextMemory/REEAgent/CausalGridWorldV2/e2.world_forward/e3.harm_eval/noise_floor.py all independently grepped live before writing, confirmed unchanged), phased-training spirit preserved (harm_eval_head trains on .detach()ed z_world via its own optimizer, never backprops into E1/E2; unchanged from 436a), progress instrumentation ([train] ep N/M with M=training_episodes the loop bound, verdict PASS/FAIL x10 = 5 seeds x 2 conditions, Seed/Condition boundary lines), output contract (run_id _v3, architecture_epoch, outcome exact field, write_flat_manifest stamps recording core, z_goal_stream wired via ZGoalStreamAccumulator -- reports goal_state_present=False, correctly since this config does not construct a goal_state), runner conformance (emit_outcome at end of __main__ with args in module scope -- fixes a latent args-out-of-scope NameError bug present in 436a's own bottom block), arm_cell/arm_fingerprint used per cell (RNG-fully-reset guarantee, load-bearing now that action selection is stochastic; mint-as-you-go default, no reuse claim made). (i) Smoke test (--dry-run): both conditions x 1 seed complete cleanly, verdict PASS x2, manifest correctly relocated out of evidence/experiments/ to the scratch dir before the sentinel was written (confirmed via ls + sentinel manifest_path). (j) validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 findings across all 21 checks. Ethics preflight: all-false/allow (V3, no self-model, no suffering-like state).
